title: for the same-directory basename-only writers, does the write call's own path expression compose the path the reader opens?

population_source.population_definition: rows of E488 whose directory_class is the same-directory class (the writer module names the reader directory)

fold_rule.constant: a string constant is a path fragment
fold_rule.name: module, same-function and loop-target assignments fold up to 24 hops
fold_rule.for: a for-target binds to its iterable; a tuple/list iterable folds as alternatives (the loop produces one of them)
fold_rule.join: os.path.join(a, b, ...) folds as the cartesian concatenation
fold_rule.format: 'NAME-%s.json' % x is a format string, not a path, so it does not fold
fold_rule.file: os.path.dirname(...(os.path.abspath(__file__))) folds to the module directory, walked up once per dirname wrapper
fold_rule.call: open/io.open/write_json/write_text first positional argument is the write path

class_definition.the_write_call_composes_the_exact_path_t: a folded write path equals <reader directory>/<spelling>
class_definition.the_write_call_composes_the_reader_direc: a folded write path has the reader's directory but another basename
class_definition.the_write_call_composes_a_path_in_anothe: the write call folds, and no path is in the reader's directory
class_definition.a_write_call_is_present_but_its_path_arg: a write call is found at the site but its path argument folds to nothing (parameter, argv, environment, format string)
class_definition.no_write_call_is_published_at_the_record: no write call is found at or within 2 lines of the recorded site

method_limits: the site is the line E487 traced; a write that happens in a helper called from that line is published as W_UNFOLDABLE rather than guessed
a folded path is static: a name built from a function parameter, argv, env or a dict key does not fold, and the row is published as W_UNFOLDABLE, never as wired
W_WIRED says the composed string equals the reader path; it does not claim the file exists at run time or that the write executes
a %-format string is deliberately excluded from folding, so the dated-face arm of many writers contributes no path while the LATEST arm does
the population is E488's same-directory arm kept byte-for-byte; this face adds a write-call question and does not re-open E487/E488's class questions
